step1.name: Input Parsing & Simulation Initialization
step1.purpose: Parse the user query, validate inputs, and initialize simulation memory.

subWorkflows.1.2: Context Extraction: Extract domain, sector, regulatory, location, and temporal cues.
subWorkflows.1.3: Input Validation: Syntax/grammar checks; Ambiguity detection; Security filtering.

subWorkflows.1.5: Memory Bootstrapping: Load relevant session or persistent context into working memory.

step1.description: Tier Routing (v1): Compute difficulty/stakes/ambiguity/novelty signals and assign a tier (trivial/moderate/high_stakes/extreme/autonomous) to determine workflow depth, budgets, and allowed KAs (see `tier_system`).

tier_assignment.name: Tier Assignment & Workflow Depth Selection
logic: Materialize enabled workflow steps and defaults from tier profile
Emit routing plan to orchestration controller (KA-032)

notes: TruthGate pre-checks run here: KA-004 (VALID) + KA-061 (SHIELD) + KA-107 (BOUNDARY).

step2.name: 17-Axis System Mapping & Knowledge Assembly
step2.purpose: Locate the query in 13D coordinate space and build the working subgraph.

subWorkflows.2.2: Knowledge Node Retrieval from vector and graph DBs.
subWorkflows.2.4: Metadata Extraction for regulatory, temporal, and spatial data.

axis1.name: Pillar Level
process: Match query domain keywords to Pillar IDs.
Score and select Pillar and sublevels via embedding similarity.

axis2.name: Sector of Industry
subLevel1: Score candidates and choose classification system.
subLevel2: Filter by semantic overlap with query.

axis3.name: Honeycomb Cross-Domain Links
process: Identify semantically adjacent domains from Axis1+2.
Fetch cross-domain link nodes (e.g., Healthcare ↔ AI).
Rank by co-occurrence and regulatory relevance.

axis4.name: Branch System
process: Load domain taxonomy under selected sector.
Traverse to Branch level matching query subdomain.
Use term‑frequency and embedding similarity for SubBranch.

axis5.name: Node System
process: Identify intersection nodes between branches and other axes.
Score by link strength and co‑occurrence.

axis6.name: Octopus Regulatory Crosswalk
process: Fetch high‑level regulatory frameworks tied to Axis2+4+5.
Identify hub nodes that map multiple regulations.

axis7.name: Spiderweb Compliance Crosswalk
process: Select SpiderNode with highest mesh score.

axis8.name: Knowledge Expert Persona Role
process: Map Axis8 value to expert role.
Fetch role template and skill matrix.

axis9.name: Sector/Industry Expert Persona Role
process: Map Axis9 value to practitioner role.

axis10.name: Octopus Regulatory Expert Persona
process: Map Axis10 value to regulatory authority role.

axis11.name: Spiderweb Compliance Expert Persona
process: Map Axis11 value to compliance officer role.

axis14.name: Fidelity / Confidence Scalar
axis14.description: Numeric confidence/fidelity for the knowledge object; used for promotion and SLA.

axis15.name: Risk Class
axis15.description: Risk class derived from query stakes + policy + downstream impact.

axis16.name: Evidence Maturity
axis16.description: Aggregate maturity of evidence supporting key claims.

axis17.name: State / Seal
axis17.description: Release state indicating whether the output can be persisted/served.

notes: 17-axis coordinate resolution occurs here; axes 14–17 are derived from TruthEngine outcomes (F14/R15/E16/S17).

metadata.name: Advanced Dynamic Cognitive Architecture - Enterprise Edition

axis_system.notes: Coordinate schema used to index knowledge, personas, time/location, risk, and enterprise tenancy.

tier_system.description: Dynamic tiering system that determines how much of the UKG workflow to execute based on query difficulty, stakes, ambiguity, and policy/budget constraints.

complexity_score.notes: Computed from query length, required reasoning depth, number of entities, and expected subtask graph size.

stakes_score.notes: Higher for medical/legal/financial/safety/compliance decisions, or when user marks high-stakes.

ambiguity_score.notes: Higher when intent/entities are unclear or conflicting.

novelty_score.notes: Higher when no close match exists in UKG/USKD memory or when evidence conflicts.

compliance_required.notes: True when regulated domain or user policy demands compliance validation.

sensitive_data_present.notes: True when PII/PHI/secret/proprietary indicators are detected; may force additional privacy gates.

budget_usd.notes: Optional budget cap to constrain tiers and recursion.

max_latency_ms.notes: Optional latency cap that can down-tier unless policy forbids.

tiers.goal: Fast-path answers when the system can answer from high-confidence memory or simple retrieval with minimal reasoning.
Hybrid retrieval + structured reasoning with persona activation when useful.
Full validation, evidence checking, compliance mapping, and robust audit trail generation.
Run maximal simulation, counterfactuals, and optional quantum/graph neural subcomponents under strict budget/governance.
Asynchronous multi-agent planning/execution with governance, HITL, and staged releases.

decision_rules.notes: Default to high_stakes for regulated/mission-critical domains unless policy explicitly permits down-tiering.
Very high complexity tends to require deeper simulation, counterfactuals, or advanced modeling.
If ambiguity is high but stakes are not, prioritize clarification + moderate reasoning before expensive steps.
Novel + moderately high stakes: require stronger evidence validation and audit.
Low complexity + low stakes + low ambiguity.
Budget cap can restrict tiers unless policy overrides.
Latency cap can restrict execution depth unless policy overrides.

TruthGate.purpose: Security/policy gates and capability bounds before and during execution.

TruthMemory.purpose: Controlled persistence, containment, lifecycle, and release management.

rules.no_persist_without_pass: Require TrustGate pass + Confidence >= tier threshold + Containment != never + KB integrity pass.
rules.external_research_bounded: Only via KA-114 and only when tier defaults allow_external_research=true; evidence must pass TruthCore before use.
rules.chaos_governed: Chaos (KA-101) only when allow_chaos=true and risk < H and compliance gates not active.
